name: transport-budget-final
description: Live chat regression: a ₹19,000 budget that includes transport, a ₹17,500 offer for the bed after a ₹1,500 truck quote, then the same amount called final. Kritva counters once and then holds, never hinting at a limit.

turns.buyer: My total budget is ₹19,000 including transport. I don’t know what a truck will cost yet.
The truck quote is ₹1,500, so I can pay ₹17,500 for the bed and collect it myself.
₹17,500 is my final offer. I’ll collect it myself.
